```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)
library(skimr)
library(naniar)
library(gridExtra)

# Read train and test data
train <- read_csv("SkinCancerTrain.csv")
test  <- read_csv("SkinCancerTestNoY.csv")

# Ensure Cancer is a factor
train$Cancer <- as.factor(train$Cancer)

# Variables we are dropping
drop_vars <- c(
  "ID",
  "zip_code_last_digit",
  "favorite_cuisine",
  "music_genre",
  "preferred_shoe_type",
  "phone_brand",
  "monthly_screen_time_minutes",
  "uses_smartwatch",
  "desk_height_cm",
  "commute_minutes",
  "participates_outdoor_sports",
  "years_lived_at_address",
  "pets",
  "favorite_color",
  "residence_lat", 
  "residence_lon",
  "income",
  "education"
)
```
```{r}
# Count missing values per variable
missing_summary <- train %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_missing") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_missing))

missing_summary
```

```{r}
# Clean training data
train_clean <- train %>% 
  select(-all_of(drop_vars)) %>%
  mutate(
    Cancer = factor(Cancer, levels = c("Benign", "Malignant")),
    across(where(is.character), as.factor)
  )

# Clean test data
test_clean <- test %>% 
  select(-any_of(drop_vars)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
```

```{r}
# IMPUTATION - ensure there are no NAs in data

# Calculate imputation values from TRAINING data only
train_medians <- train_clean %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~median(., na.rm = TRUE)))

train_modes <- train_clean %>%
  select(where(is.factor), -Cancer) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~names(sort(table(.), decreasing = TRUE))[1]))

# Impute training data
train_final <- train_clean
for (col in names(train_medians)) {
  if (col %in% names(train_final)) {
    train_final[[col]][is.na(train_final[[col]])] <- train_medians[[col]]
  }
}

for (col in names(train_modes)) {
  if (col %in% names(train_final)) {
    train_final[[col]][is.na(train_final[[col]])] <- train_modes[[col]]
    train_final[[col]] <- factor(train_final[[col]], levels = levels(train_clean[[col]]))
  }
}

# Impute test data using TRAINING statistics
test_final <- test_clean
for (col in names(train_medians)) {
  if (col %in% names(test_final)) {
    test_final[[col]][is.na(test_final[[col]])] <- train_medians[[col]]
  }
}

for (col in names(train_modes)) {
  if (col %in% names(test_final)) {
    test_final[[col]][is.na(test_final[[col]])] <- train_modes[[col]]
  }
}

# Align factor levels between train and test
for (col in intersect(names(train_final), names(test_final))) {
  if (is.factor(train_final[[col]])) {
    test_final[[col]] <- factor(test_final[[col]], 
                                 levels = levels(train_final[[col]]))
  }
}

# Verify no missing values remain
cat("\nMissing values in training after imputation:\n")
print(colSums(is.na(train_final)))

cat("\nMissing values in test after imputation:\n")
print(colSums(is.na(test_final)))

cat("\nFinal training dimensions:", dim(train_final), "\n")
cat("Final test dimensions:", dim(test_final), "\n")
```

## Candidate Models
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rpart)
library(randomForest)
library(xgboost)
library(class)
library(pROC)
```

```{r}
# BASELINE ACCURACY CHECK

cat("\n=== BASELINE CHECK ===\n")
table(train_final$Cancer)
prop.table(table(train_final$Cancer))

baseline_acc <- max(prop.table(table(train_final$Cancer)))
cat("Baseline accuracy:", round(baseline_acc, 4), "\n") # models must be greater than this
```

```{r}
# Create validation split from training for model evaluation
set.seed(123)
val_idx <- sample(1:nrow(train_final), 0.2 * nrow(train_final))
val_set <- train_final[val_idx, ]
train_subset <- train_final[-val_idx, ]

cat("Training subset for validation:", nrow(train_subset), "observations\n")
cat("Validation set:", nrow(val_set), "observations\n")
```

### MODEL 1: LOGISTIC REGRESSION
```{r}
cat("\n=== LOGISTIC REGRESSION ===\n")
model_logit <- glm(Cancer ~ ., data = train_subset, family = binomial)

# Predictions
prob_logit_val <- predict(model_logit, newdata = val_set, type = "response")
pred_logit_val <- factor(ifelse(prob_logit_val > 0.5, "Malignant", "Benign"),
                         levels = c("Benign", "Malignant"))

# Evaluation
conf_logit <- table(Predicted = pred_logit_val, Actual = val_set$Cancer)
acc_logit <- sum(diag(conf_logit)) / sum(conf_logit)
roc_logit <- roc(val_set$Cancer, prob_logit_val, levels = c("Benign", "Malignant"))

# MSE
y_true <- ifelse(val_set$Cancer == "Malignant", 1, 0)
mse_logit <- mean((prob_logit_val - y_true)^2)

cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_logit, 4), "\n")
cat("AUC:", round(auc(roc_logit), 4), "\n")
cat("MSE:", round(mse_logit, 4), "\n\n")
print(conf_logit)
```

### MODEL 2: DECISION TREE
```{r}
cat("\n=== DECISION TREE ===\n")
model_tree <- rpart(Cancer ~ ., data = train_subset, 
                    method = "class",
                    control = rpart.control(cp = 0.01, minsplit = 20))

# Predictions
prob_tree_val <- predict(model_tree, newdata = val_set, type = "prob")[, 2]
pred_tree_val <- predict(model_tree, newdata = val_set, type = "class")

# Evaluation
conf_tree <- table(Predicted = pred_tree_val, Actual = val_set$Cancer)
acc_tree <- sum(diag(conf_tree)) / sum(conf_tree)
roc_tree <- roc(val_set$Cancer, prob_tree_val, levels = c("Benign", "Malignant"))

# MSE
y_true <- ifelse(val_set$Cancer == "Malignant", 1, 0)
mse_tree <- mean((prob_tree_val - y_true)^2)

cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_tree, 4), "\n")
cat("AUC:", round(auc(roc_tree), 4), "\n")
cat("MSE:", round(mse_tree, 4), "\n\n")
print(conf_tree)
```

### MODEL 3: RANDOM FOREST
```{r}
cat("\n=== RANDOM FOREST ===\n")
model_rf <- randomForest(Cancer ~ ., data = train_subset,
                        ntree = 500,
                        mtry = sqrt(ncol(train_subset) - 1),
                        importance = TRUE)

# Predictions
prob_rf_val <- predict(model_rf, newdata = val_set, type = "prob")[, 2]
pred_rf_val <- predict(model_rf, newdata = val_set, type = "class")

# Evaluation
conf_rf <- table(Predicted = pred_rf_val, Actual = val_set$Cancer)
acc_rf <- sum(diag(conf_rf)) / sum(conf_rf)
roc_rf <- roc(val_set$Cancer, prob_rf_val, levels = c("Benign", "Malignant"))

# MSE
y_true <- ifelse(val_set$Cancer == "Malignant", 1, 0)
mse_rf <- mean((prob_rf_val - y_true)^2)

cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_rf, 4), "\n")
cat("AUC:", round(auc(roc_rf), 4), "\n")
cat("MSE:", round(mse_rf, 4), "\n\n")
print(conf_rf)

# Variable importance
cat("\nTop 10 Important Variables:\n")
importance_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(importance(model_rf)),
  MeanDecreaseGini = importance(model_rf)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>% arrange(desc(MeanDecreaseGini))
print(head(importance_df, 10))
```

### MODEL 4: XGBOOST
```{r}
cat("\n=== XGBOOST ===\n")

# Prepare numeric matrix for XGBoost
prep_xgb_data <- function(df, target_col = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(target_col)) {
    y <- as.numeric(df[[target_col]]) - 1  # 0/1 encoding
    X <- df %>% select(-all_of(target_col))
  } else {
    y <- NULL
    X <- df
  }
  
  # Convert factors to dummy variables
  X_numeric <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = X)
  
  if (!is.null(y)) {
    return(list(X = X_numeric, y = y))
  } else {
    return(X_numeric)
  }
}

train_xgb <- prep_xgb_data(train_subset, "Cancer")
val_xgb <- prep_xgb_data(val_set, "Cancer")

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = train_xgb$X, label = train_xgb$y)
dval <- xgb.DMatrix(data = val_xgb$X, label = val_xgb$y)

model_xgb <- xgboost(
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 100,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eta = 0.1,
  max_depth = 6,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  eval_metric = "auc",
  verbose = 0
)

# Predictions
prob_xgb_val <- predict(model_xgb, dval)
pred_xgb_val <- factor(ifelse(prob_xgb_val > 0.5, "Malignant", "Benign"),
                       levels = c("Benign", "Malignant"))

# Evaluation
conf_xgb <- table(Predicted = pred_xgb_val, Actual = val_set$Cancer)
acc_xgb <- sum(diag(conf_xgb)) / sum(conf_xgb)
roc_xgb <- roc(val_set$Cancer, prob_xgb_val, levels = c("Benign", "Malignant"))

# MSE
y_true <- ifelse(val_set$Cancer == "Malignant", 1, 0)
mse_xgb <- mean((prob_xgb_val - y_true)^2)

cat("Accuracy:", round(acc_xgb, 4), "\n")
cat("AUC:", round(auc(roc_xgb), 4), "\n")
cat("MSE:", round(mse_xgb, 4), "\n\n")
print(conf_xgb)
```

## K FOLD CROSS VALIDATION
```{r}
library(mlr3)
library(mlr3learners)

train_encoded <- model.matrix(~ . - Cancer, data = train_final) %>% 
  as.data.frame()
train_encoded$Cancer <- train_final$Cancer

cancer_tsk <- as_task_classif(train_encoded, target = "Cancer", positive = "Malignant")

learner_logit <- lrn("classif.log_reg", predict_type = "prob")

learner_tree <- lrn("classif.rpart", 
                    predict_type = "prob",
                    cp = 0.01,
                    minsplit = 20)

learner_rf <- lrn("classif.ranger",
                  predict_type = "prob",
                  num.trees = 500,
                  mtry = round(sqrt(cancer_tsk$ncol - 1)))

learner_xgb <- lrn("classif.xgboost",
                   predict_type = "prob",
                   nrounds = 100,
                   eta = 0.1,
                   max_depth = 6,
                   subsample = 0.8,
                   colsample_bytree = 0.8)

models <- list(
  "Logistic" = learner_logit,
  "Tree" = learner_tree,
  "RandomForest" = learner_rf,
  "XGBoost" = learner_xgb
)

set.seed(101)
rsmp_cv10 <- rsmp("cv", folds = 10)
rrs <- list()

for(i in names(models)) {
  cat("Training:", i, "\n")
  rr <- resample(task = cancer_tsk,
                     learner = models[[i]],
                     resampling = rsmp_cv10)
  rrs[[i]] <- rr
  accuracy <- rr$aggregate(msr("classif.acc"))
  auc <- rr$aggregate(msr("classif.auc"))
  err <- rr$aggregate(msr("classif.ce"))
  cat("  Accuracy:", accuracy, "\n")
  cat("  AUC:", auc, "\n")
  cat("  Mean Error:", err, "\n")
}

summary_table <- data.frame(
  Model = names(rrs),
  Accuracy = sapply(rrs, function(x) round(x$aggregate(msr("classif.acc")), 4)),
  AUC = sapply(rrs, function(x) round(x$aggregate(msr("classif.auc")), 4)),
  Error = sapply(rrs, function(x) round(x$aggregate(msr("classif.ce")), 4))
)
```

## MODEL COMPARISON
```{r}
library(mlr3learners)
results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Logistic Regression", "Decision Tree", "Random Forest", "XGBoost"),
  Accuracy = c(acc_logit, acc_tree, acc_rf, acc_xgb),
  AUC = c(auc(roc_logit), auc(roc_tree), auc(roc_rf), auc(roc_xgb))
) %>% arrange(desc(AUC))

print(results)

# Plot ROC curves
plot(roc_logit, col = "red", main = "ROC Curves Comparison")
plot(roc_tree, col = "blue", add = TRUE)
plot(roc_rf, col = "green", add = TRUE)
plot(roc_xgb, col = "purple", add = TRUE)
legend("bottomright", 
       legend = c("Logistic", "Tree", "Random Forest", "XGBoost"),
       col = c("red", "blue", "green", "purple"), 
       lwd = 2)

scores <- data.frame()
for(i in names(rrs)) {
  s <- rrs[[i]]$score(measures = msrs(c("classif.acc", "classif.ce", "classif.auc")))
  s$Model <- i
  scores <- rbind(scores, s)
}

# PLOT ACCURACY COMPARISON
ggplot(scores, aes(x = Model, y = classif.acc, fill = Model)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "CV Accuracy by Model",
       x = "Model",
       y = "Accuracy") +
  theme_minimal() 

# PLOT ERROR COMPARISON
ggplot(scores, aes(x = Model, y = classif.ce, fill = Model)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "CV Mean Error by Model",
       x = "Model",
       y = "Classification Error") +
  theme_minimal() 


```

```{r}
# 3. XGBOOST SUBMISSION
cat("=== XGBOOST ===\n")

# Prepare data function
prep_xgb_data <- function(df, target_col = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(target_col)) {
    y <- as.numeric(df[[target_col]]) - 1
    X <- df %>% select(-all_of(target_col))
  } else {
    y <- NULL
    X <- df
  }
  
  X_numeric <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = X)
  
  if (!is.null(y)) {
    return(list(X = X_numeric, y = y))
  } else {
    return(X_numeric)
  }
}

train_xgb_full <- prep_xgb_data(train_final, "Cancer")
dtrain_full <- xgb.DMatrix(data = train_xgb_full$X, label = train_xgb_full$y)

model_xgb_full <- xgboost(
  data = dtrain_full,
  nrounds = 100,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eta = 0.1,
  max_depth = 6,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  eval_metric = "auc",
  verbose = 0
)

test_xgb_matrix <- prep_xgb_data(test_final)
dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = test_xgb_matrix)
prob_test_xgb <- predict(model_xgb_full, dtest)
pred_test_xgb <- ifelse(prob_test_xgb > 0.5, "Malignant", "Benign")

submission_xgb <- data.frame(
  ID = test$ID,
  Cancer = pred_test_xgb
)

write_csv(submission_xgb, "submission_xgb.csv")
cat("  Predictions:", table(pred_test_xgb), "\n\n")

# 4. ENSEMBLE SUBMISSION
cat("=== ENSEMBLE (RF + XGBoost Average) ===\n")

# Average the probabilities from RF and XGBoost
prob_test_ensemble <- (prob_test_rf + prob_test_xgb) / 2
pred_test_ensemble <- ifelse(prob_test_ensemble > 0.5, "Malignant", "Benign")

submission_ensemble <- data.frame(
  ID = test$ID,
  Cancer = pred_test_ensemble
)

write_csv(submission_ensemble, "submission_ensemble.csv")
cat("  Predictions:", table(pred_test_ensemble), "\n\n")

# 5. SUMMARY
# Compare prediction distributions
comparison <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Logistic", "Random Forest", "XGBoost", "Ensemble"),
  Benign = c(
    sum(pred_test_logit == "Benign"),
    sum(pred_test_rf == "Benign"),
    sum(pred_test_xgb == "Benign"),
    sum(pred_test_ensemble == "Benign")
  ),
  Malignant = c(
    sum(pred_test_logit == "Malignant"),
    sum(pred_test_rf == "Malignant"),
    sum(pred_test_xgb == "Malignant"),
    sum(pred_test_ensemble == "Malignant")
  )
)

comparison <- comparison %>%
  mutate(
    Total = Benign + Malignant,
    Pct_Malignant = round(100 * Malignant / Total, 2)
  )

print(comparison)
```
